output.content: When we need to compare the current weekly retrain against the previous iteration, I open the shared spreadsheet in the team drive. It lists the training run identifier, the date, and the root mean squared error for the fourteen day horizon. I manually copy the relevant row into the notebook to load the archived weights from the object storage bucket. There is no central service that maps a store or article to the specific model version currently serving its forecast. If a discrepancy appears in the morning order window, I check the spreadsheet to see which build was deployed the night before. The file is updated by hand after each successful retrain cycle, and I keep a local backup of the last three versions on my workstation.
